prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: one exceptionally polished native mobile fitness tracking app screen, portrait 9:16, high resolution. All UI edge to edge, straight on, flat screenshot; no device hardware, no perspective, no mockup collage, no captions outside the screen.
Input image 1: official Peloton app product composition is a STYLE AND INFORMATION HIERARCHY REFERENCE only. Input image 2: official Strength+ workout composition is a STYLE reference only. Create a new single original app screen, not a copy of the composition or phones.
Original fitness tracker named FORM, informed by a visual study of current Peloton App, Strength+, Bike+, Row, Tread and Peloton IQ. Matte graphite #15171B and near-black #0B0C0F, off-white type, subtle charcoal divisions, gentle 14px corners. Contemporary readable neo-grotesk typography, medium weight, sentence case, tabular metrics. Normal width typography, no condensed display fonts. Photography is the hero: richly detailed editorial real human movement, premium dark studio with soft light, natural skin, calm confidence, no dystopian neon. White pill primary controls. Purple #8068EF is reserved for completed days and progress; small peach accents for time. Accent colors are functional, not glowing. Cohesive open sections and an uninterrupted weekly rhythm rather than a wall of dashboard cards. No banking ledger aesthetic, no white dashboard, no neon-green recovery dial, no circular score as centerpiece, no chrome/gloss/3D bevels, no generic SaaS gradient blobs. Icons are small consistent line icons. All text crisp and readable with deliberate padding. This is an original concept, not a fake official Peloton screenshot; use FORM wordmark, no Peloton logo or real instructor identity.
Fictional date Sunday Oct 25, 2026, selected week Oct 19–25. Completed: Mon19 45min Ride, Wed21 35min Strength, Sat24 60min Run. Total 140min, 3active days,3of4 weekly workouts complete. Tue20,Thu22,Fri23 Rest. Sun25 has planned 20min Mobility, still not completed and not included in totals. Violet completed checkmarks only Mon19/Wed21/Sat24; Sunday an outlined selection. Coach Maya Chen is fictional. Latest run 60min,7.2km,8:20/km,avgHR134bpm.
Design a dense but breathable complete Home screen at a believable mobile scale. Status bar 9:41. Small FORM wordmark and circular account avatar in top row. Heading 'Your week' with subdued 'Oct 19–25' and small calendar action. Below use ONE slim horizontal day rail Mon through Sun, each number19–25 exactly once. The three completed days have small violet filled check markers, other days muted, Sunday selected outlined. A quiet integrated stats line beneath: '3/4 Workouts', '140 min', '3 Active days'. Tiny progress line is three-quarters filled, not a big card.
The central and largest region is a beautifully composed photographic upcoming session occupying around 43% of screen height: fictional Asian female movement coach in a charcoal performance top, doing a controlled standing side lunge on a charcoal mat in a modern studio, dramatically cropped but natural anatomically correct movement, warm soft side light and slightly lavender grey studio backdrop. Subtle bottom fade for white text. Top-left a small label 'TODAY · RECOVERY'. At photo bottom large clear '20 min Mobility', small 'Maya Chen · All levels' and a beautiful white pill 'Start session' with black play icon. One clear supporting sentence beneath or above image: 'A little space to reset.'
Lower section 'Recent activity' / 'View all' with TWO flat compact rows: square photos, '60 min Outdoor Run' / 'Sat, Oct 24 · Easy' and '35 min Full Body Strength' / 'Wed, Oct 21 · Moderate', trailing check icons. No card borders around each. Bottom navigation exactly 'Today', 'Plan', 'Progress', 'You'; Today selected white, others muted. Home indicator. Fit every section entirely in view, no clipped text or cropped bottom bar. Slick, serious, warm premium consumer fitness product. A visually striking but highly functional tracker, not a marketing poster.
